privacy: No owner question, memory, model excerpts, paths or identifiers are included.
failure_observed: The question-relevance model returned one correct decision but omitted three other candidates. The strict batch validator discarded the correct decision with the incomplete receipt.
change: Keep every structurally valid explicit decision from the first response.
Retry once with only the omitted candidates.
Treat candidates omitted again as unrelated, so they remain blocked.
Never turn an omitted candidate into accepted evidence.
test: A four-candidate replay keeps the one correct answer, retries only the other three, rejects them as unrelated and completes the supported answer.
claim_boundary: The deterministic replay passes. The same physical owner-memory question must still be repeated in the packaged application.
